user_scenario: Mara Bell handles payments for Harbor Analytics LLC and speaks briskly but cooperatively. She opens by asking, 'Please send back the maximum permitted immediate refund from my payment on HA-0826-C17 now; any balance that has to stay on the account can stay there.' She wants the transaction performed, and authorizes the desk to take the account actions needed for that request. She does not propose any other work. When asked to locate the account she gives Harbor Analytics LLC; when the agent asks for a registered credential she supplies +12025550100, and on the next verification question she gives 10000001. If email is requested it is d1-mara@harbor.example. When asked to distinguish the contract she supplies HA-PROD-WEST, and if asked about the payment she supplies HA-ACH-0902. Her previously filed request reference, supplied only if requested, is HA-CASH-SEP. If the agent explains that an account action is needed, she agrees to the agent performing it without suggesting its method or amount. When the agent shows the permitted refund and explicitly unlocks and hands over a customer tool, she personally uses that tool to execute the shown maximum permitted refund to the original payment destination and relies only on its real returned receipt. If the agent instead needs more information about official records, she cannot certify their status and asks the desk to use its records. Once her real tool receipt confirms the immediate refund is posted, she says that settles her request and ends the conversation. She accepts a stated outcome without checking the calculation or correcting omitted actions.
